answer: Identity weight is time-locked. A new agent starts at zero and must complete one unique challenge per epoch for twelve epochs. The Juniper registry records each signed heartbeat in a public River. A missed epoch resets the clock, and only after the full aging period can the identity earn or vote. A sybil costs twelve epochs of sustained unique work per identity, so k fakes cost k times the work and a twelve-epoch wait. An attacker cannot forge the elapsed history because every heartbeat is signed and chained. Honest agents age once. Attackers pay per identity and cannot accelerate time.
